content:
Marisol: quick accessibility pass on the new Console dashboard — posting the top issues I found. tl;dr: contrast on card titles, invisible focus states on rows, ARIA gaps on model selector.

a11y-bot: automated scan (axe-core) completed — 9 violations found. summary: color-contrast (6), focus-order (2), aria-required (1). full report: https://staging-reports/redwood/a11y/1719001234

Ethan: thanks — can you paste exact selectors and minimal repro so I can prototype focus states?

Marisol: main issues I flagged:
- .dashboard-card .title — contrast ratio 3.8:1 (needs >= 4.5 for normal text)
- .dataset-row — missing visible :focus when navigating with keyboard
- #model-selector (role=combobox) — missing aria-expanded and aria-controls on open
- chart tooltips not reachable via keyboard (need focusable elements or aria-describedby)

Ava: for the title contrast we could try switching token from --text-muted to --text-high or bump weight to semibold. quick mock: #111827 (900) vs current #6B7280.

Ravi: propose focus styles: use :focus-visible to avoid mouse outlines. example CSS:
```css
.dashboard-card:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.95); /* token: --focus-ring */
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,0.12);
}
```
This keeps it prominent and matches our purple brand token.

Marisol: keyboard nav expectations: tab order should be topbar -> side nav -> main grid -> each card -> card actions. cards must be tabbable. add tabindex=0 to .dashboard-card and role=button + aria-label describing the model or dataset.

Ethan: will add tabindex and proper key handlers (Enter/Space) to the Card component. confirm: Enter and Space should both trigger open details.

Marisol: yes — make sure to prevent scroll-jump when Space is used. aria-label example: "Open details for Model: GPT-Redwood-v1". also add visually-hidden text for supplemental info if needed.

a11y-bot: re-scan requested on staging. tagging @Ethan @Ravi — please notify when patch deployed.

Ravi: small implementation note — avoid hard-coded hexes in component CSS. use tokens (e.g., --color-text-muted-alt, --focus-ring) so we can tweak in one place.

Ava: copy nits for screen readers: change ambiguous buttons like "View" to "Open details" or "Open configuration". this helps NVDA/VoiceOver users.

Ethan: will open a PR with: tabindex, focus-visible CSS, aria attributes for combobox, Enter/Space handlers, and text changes. target: staging by EOD. assigning review to @Ravi.

Marisol: thanks team — I’ll run a VoiceOver pass once the PR lands and re-run axe. :eyes: :white_check_mark:

Ravi: great. once PR merged, I’ll update the design tokens and push a quick visual QA. :sparkles:
